exercise.name: Cable Concentration Curl
library_steps: Sit or kneel by a low pulley with your elbow braced on your thigh.
Curl the handle up to your shoulder without moving your upper arm.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
exercise.one_line_summary: Seated on a bench end leaning forward, the back of one upper arm braced on the inside of the thigh; the hand curls a D-handle from a low pulley up toward the shoulder, elbow ~15 to ~125 deg, without moving the upper arm. Biceps does the work; the other hand rests on the knee.

setup.target: Back of the upper arm on the inner thigh near the knee.
setup.why: Library step; braced upper arm like the preacher position (S1).

setup.target: Low, in front of the working-side foot.

muscles.emg: Biceps long head at least 50 % of max in every curl position incl. braced (preacher) (S1); main elbow flexor (S2).
muscles.role: Bends the elbow; what the exercise is for.
Helps bend the elbow; library secondary.
muscles.surface: Thumb side of the upper forearm.

mistakes.mistake: Upper arm lifting off the thigh
mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Elbow leaves the thigh as the hand rises.
mistakes.why_it_matters: The brace is the point of the exercise.

sources.citation: Oliveira LF, Matta TT, Alves DS, Garcia MA, Vieira TM. 2009. Effect of the shoulder position on the biceps brachii EMG in different dumbbell curls. J Sports Sci Med 8(1):24-29.
sources.what_it_gave: Standing, incline (shoulder extended) and preacher curls: biceps long head at least 50 % of max RMS in all; shoulder position shifts where in the range the biceps works hardest.

sources.citation: Marcolin G, Panizzolo FA, Petrone N, et al. 2018. Differences in electromyographic activity of biceps brachii and brachioradialis while performing three variants of curl. PeerJ 6:e5165.
sources.what_it_gave: Straight bar, EZ bar and dumbbell curls at 65 % 1RM: biceps and brachioradialis both clearly active; elbow range ~117 deg.
